dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

colorStepValues.description:
An array of values to which the property value is compared.

Example: [0, 10, 20, 30] => values 0-10 will be the first color in {@link #stepColors},
values > 30 will be the fourth color in {@link #stepColors}. This implies that the array lengths in
{@link #stepColors} and {@link #colorStepValues} must be the same. Note, the first value should usually be 0.

stepColors.description:
The array of colors that will be matched with the corresponding values in
{@link #colorStepValues}.
